settings: parallelism 1, table.local-time-zone = UTC, pipeline.auto-watermark-interval = 0 ms, watermark = event_time - 5 s
editWarsSql:
SELECT wiki, title, first_revert, third_revert
FROM recentchange
MATCH_RECOGNIZE (
  PARTITION BY wiki, title
  ORDER BY event_time
  MEASURES
    R1.event_time AS first_revert,
    R3.event_time AS third_revert
  ONE ROW PER MATCH
  AFTER MATCH SKIP PAST LAST ROW
  PATTERN (R1 O1*? R2 O2*? R3) WITHIN INTERVAL '15' MINUTE
  DEFINE
    R1 AS REGEXP(R1.edit_comment, '(?iu)(undid revision|undo revision|reverted edits? by|reverted to revision|restored revision|^rvv?\b|^revert|rückgängig|annulation|revertid|annullat|отмена правки|отменены правки|取り消し|ロールバック)'),
    R2 AS REGEXP(R2.edit_comment, '(?iu)(undid revision|undo revision|reverted edits? by|reverted to revision|restored revision|^rvv?\b|^revert|rückgängig|annulation|revertid|annullat|отмена правки|отменены правки|取り消し|ロールバック)'),
    R3 AS REGEXP(R3.edit_comment, '(?iu)(undid revision|undo revision|reverted edits? by|reverted to revision|restored revision|^rvv?\b|^revert|rückgängig|annulation|revertid|annullat|отмена правки|отменены правки|取り消し|ロールバック)') AND (R2.user_name <> R1.user_name OR R3.user_name <> R1.user_name),
    O1 AS NOT REGEXP(O1.edit_comment, '(?iu)(undid revision|undo revision|reverted edits? by|reverted to revision|restored revision|^rvv?\b|^revert|rückgängig|annulation|revertid|annullat|отмена правки|отменены правки|取り消し|ロールバック)'),
    O2 AS NOT REGEXP(O2.edit_comment, '(?iu)(undid revision|undo revision|reverted edits? by|reverted to revision|restored revision|^rvv?\b|^revert|rückgängig|annulation|revertid|annullat|отмена правки|отменены правки|取り消し|ロールバック)')
)
